main_text.p: NOBILES & Magnifici Viri, qua fiducia hos meos tractatus, quos tanquam immaturos & crudos embryones abortii, vobis prudentia, eruditione, virtute maturis, splendoreq; gloriæ, opibus, plena autoritatis & dignitatis senecta floretibus, ausus sim ascribere, & in tutelam vestram tradere, non immerito miramini. Sed mirari desinetis, cum partim virtute, humanitate & fauore vestro, quo Musarum cultores ac politioris literaturæ studiosos semper estis complexi, partim egregia erga familiam nostră benevolentia & affectione, persuasum me ad id esse & adductum intellexeritis. page.notes: The initial N is a decorative woodcut, joined to "OBILES" as "NOBILES". Text reads "splēdo-re" with a tilde over e; "nostră" and "vestrę" carry abbreviation marks as printed. The final word "val-" is hyphenated at the line end and continues on the next page. Right margin contains only show-through and the adjacent page's edge, omitted.
